== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|A Path is a specialized discipline within the [[sacred arts]] that functions as a journey for its practitioner. While there are countless variations—such as the [[Path of the Endless Sword]], the [[Path of the White Fox]], or the [[Path of Black Flame]]—sages suggest that all these diverse routes can ultimately be distilled into a single goal: self-improvement. [[Paths]] provide the framework for gaining power and can dictate how a person prepares for [[advancement]] through different stages of strength. Some [[Paths]] are highly specialized, such as the [[Path of Ten Thousand Dreams]] which focuses on sharing memories and thoughts, or the Path of [[Raging Sky]] which balances multiple elemental [[aspects]]. Certain disciplines, like those centered on [[blood]] or swords, are sometimes referred to as [[slaughter Paths]] due to their violent nature. While many practitioners follow ancient instructions, it is possible for an individual to forge and document their own unique Path. Success on any given Path requires significant resolve and desire, particularly when attempting to progress beyond the [[Gold stage]]. Ultimately, a Path is a means of navigating Way{{!}}the Way, which serves as a source of orderly power that protects against chaos.}}
